hero.title: Redefining the Way You Manage Money
hero.subtitle: We believe everyone deserves a simple, secure, and powerful way to manage their financial future.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.statement: Empowering Better Lives Through Financial Clarity
mission.description: We believe that a better future begins with the right tools. Our mission is to provide families with a simple, all-in-one platform to make smarter financial decisions. By helping our users understand how they spend, save, and earn, we aim to tackle a fundamental challenge in society: the lack of financial literacy. From budgeting to investing, Wonder.Money brings everything together to give you the confidence to manage your financial journey.

story.title: Our Story
story.paragraph1: We started WonderMoney because we were frustrated. Managing personal finances in Europe meant juggling five different apps - one for each bank account, another for budgets, a spreadsheet for investments, and still never having a clear picture. The tools that existed were either built for the US market, overpriced, or too complicated for everyday use.
story.paragraph2: So we built what we wanted to use ourselves: a single, beautifully simple app that connects to your banks via Open Banking, organizes your transactions automatically, tracks your budgets, and monitors your investments. All in one place, built for Europeans, at a price that makes sense.
story.paragraph3: We're still early. WonderMoney is growing fast, shaped by feedback from real users who are part of our beta. Every week we ship new features, fix what's broken, and get closer to our vision: a world where understanding your finances is effortless. We're building this in Portugal, for Europe, and we're just getting started.

fireCalculator.heroTitle: Calculate Your Path to Financial Independence
fireCalculator.heroSubtitle: Find out when you can achieve FIRE — Financial Independence, Retire Early. Then use WonderMoney to track your progress toward that number every day.
fireCalculator.whatBody1: FIRE stands for Financial Independence, Retire Early. The goal is to accumulate enough invested assets that the passive income they generate covers your living expenses — freeing you from the need to work.
fireCalculator.whatBody2: The classic FIRE number is 25x your annual expenses, based on the 4% rule — a theoretical model derived from historical market data, not a guarantee. Real-world returns vary, so treat this figure as an illustrative starting point rather than financial advice.
fireCalculator.whatBody3: For most Europeans, FIRE is not about never working again — it is about having the freedom to choose. To take a lower-paying job you love, retire a decade early, or simply have a safety net large enough that work becomes optional.

howToCalculateNetWorth.metaTitle: How to Calculate Net Worth — Complete Guide | WonderMoney
howToCalculateNetWorth.metaDescription: Learn how to calculate your net worth step by step. What to include, what to exclude, and how to track it over time. Free net worth tracker included.
howToCalculateNetWorth.heroTitle: How to Calculate Your Net Worth
howToCalculateNetWorth.heroSubtitle: Net worth is the single most important number in personal finance. Here is exactly how to calculate it — and how to track it automatically.
howToCalculateNetWorth.whatBody: Net worth is the difference between everything you own (assets) and everything you owe (liabilities). It is the financial equivalent of a balance sheet — a snapshot of where you stand right now.
howToCalculateNetWorth.formulaLabel: Net Worth = Total Assets − Total Liabilities
howToCalculateNetWorth.whyTitle: Why Net Worth Matters More Than Income
howToCalculateNetWorth.whyBody: Income tells you how much flows in. Net worth tells you how much you have actually kept. Two people with the same salary can have wildly different net worths depending on their spending habits, debt levels, and investment decisions. Net worth is the scoreboard that actually matters.
howToCalculateNetWorth.assetsBody: Assets are everything you own that has financial value. Be thorough — most people underestimate their assets by forgetting certain categories.
howToCalculateNetWorth.assetCategory3Items: Market value of any property you own (not the purchase price)
howToCalculateNetWorth.assetNote: Use current market value, not purchase price or sentimental value. Your pension pot counts — check your most recent statement.
howToCalculateNetWorth.liabilitiesBody: Liabilities are everything you owe. Include the outstanding balance, not the original loan amount.
howToCalculateNetWorth.liabilityCategory1Items: Outstanding balance on any property loan
howToCalculateNetWorth.liabilityCategory2Items: Car loans, personal loans, credit card balances
howToCalculateNetWorth.liabilityCategory4Items: BNPL balances, money owed to friends or family
howToCalculateNetWorth.calculateTitle: Step 3: Subtract to Get Your Number
howToCalculateNetWorth.calculateBody: Once you have both totals, the calculation is straightforward: subtract total liabilities from total assets. The result is your net worth. It can be positive or negative — negative is common early in life when mortgage and student loan balances dominate.
howToCalculateNetWorth.trackBody: A one-time calculation is useful. Monthly tracking is transformative. Watching your net worth grow month by month makes the impact of your saving and investment decisions visible. It also reveals problems early — months where net worth shrinks despite stable income are a signal worth investigating.
howToCalculateNetWorth.autoBody: Doing this manually every month requires pulling data from every bank, broker, and loan account. WonderMoney connects directly to your bank accounts via Open Banking and imports your investment portfolio, then calculates and updates your net worth every day automatically — no spreadsheet required.
howToCalculateNetWorth.faq1Q: Should I include my pension in net worth?
howToCalculateNetWorth.faq1A: Yes. Your pension pot is an asset. Include the current value from your most recent pension statement. It is illiquid, but it is real wealth.
howToCalculateNetWorth.faq2Q: Should I include my home in net worth?
howToCalculateNetWorth.faq2A: Include your home at current market value (not purchase price), then subtract the outstanding mortgage as a liability. The difference — your equity — is part of your net worth.
howToCalculateNetWorth.faq3Q: How often should I calculate my net worth?
howToCalculateNetWorth.faq3A: Monthly is ideal. It is frequent enough to spot trends and react to changes, but not so frequent that short-term market fluctuations cause unnecessary anxiety.
howToCalculateNetWorth.faq4Q: What is a good net worth by age?
howToCalculateNetWorth.faq4A: There is no universal answer — it depends on income, country, family situation, and goals. A useful benchmark: aim for net worth equal to 1x your annual income by age 30, 3x by 40, and 6x by 50.
howToCalculateNetWorth.ctaBody: Connect your accounts and WonderMoney calculates your complete net worth every day. No spreadsheets. Free and open source.

featureBudgeting.metaTitle: Envelope Budgeting App for Europe — WonderMoney
featureBudgeting.metaDescription: Zero-based envelope budgeting with automatic transaction import. WonderMoney brings YNAB-style budgeting to European bank accounts via Open Banking.
featureBudgeting.heroTitle: Budget Every Euro Before You Spend It
featureBudgeting.heroSubtitle: Envelope budgeting: the method that tells you exactly where your money goes. WonderMoney gives every euro a job before the month begins.
featureBudgeting.whatBody: Envelope budgeting (also called zero-based budgeting) means allocating your entire income to categories before the month starts, until every euro is assigned. When a category runs out, you stop spending there, or consciously move money from another envelope. It is the most effective budgeting method because it forces intentional decisions about every euro.
featureBudgeting.step1Body: Allocate your income across categories: rent, groceries, transport, savings, entertainment. Every euro is assigned until the balance is zero.
featureBudgeting.step2Body: Your bank transactions sync daily via Open Banking. WonderMoney categorises them automatically and deducts from the right envelope.
featureBudgeting.step3Body: See which envelopes are on track and which are overspent. Move money between categories when plans change. It happens.
featureBudgeting.step4Body: After the month closes, see where you over- or under-budgeted. Each month you build a more accurate picture of how you actually spend.

featureAccounts.whatBody: Open Banking is a European regulation (PSD2) that requires banks to give customers the ability to securely share their account data with authorised third parties. WonderMoney uses this infrastructure via Enable Banking, one of Europe's leading Open Banking providers, to connect directly to your bank.

featureNetWorth.faq1A: Your net worth is the total of all your assets (bank accounts, investments) minus your liabilities (loans, credit cards). WonderMoney calculates it automatically from your connected accounts.
featureNetWorth.faq2Q: How often does my net worth update?
featureNetWorth.faq2A: WonderMoney refreshes net worth when your connected accounts update — typically once a day for bank balances, and more frequently for investment portfolios. The history chart uses monthly snapshots.

featureNetWorth.faq3A: Yes. Each account, portfolio, and loan can be individually toggled to include or exclude it from your net worth. The dashboard shows the total with the exclusion applied.

openBankingApp.how1Body: Search for your bank in WonderMoney and start the connection — no downloads, no paperwork.
openBankingApp.how2Body: You log in on your own bank's secure portal, not inside WonderMoney. Your bank confirms the connection directly with you.
openBankingApp.how3Body: Balances and transactions sync via Open Banking and populate your budgets, net worth, and reports without any manual work.
openBankingApp.faq1A: Open Banking is a European regulation (PSD2) that lets banks securely share account data with authorised providers, at your request. It replaces manual statement downloads with a secure, direct connection.
openBankingApp.faq2Q: Can WonderMoney move money out of my account?
openBankingApp.faq2A: No. Open Banking connections in WonderMoney are strictly read-only. WonderMoney can see your balance and transactions, but it can never initiate a payment or move money.
openBankingApp.faq3Q: Who is WonderMoney's Open Banking provider?
openBankingApp.faq3A: WonderMoney uses Enable Banking, a Registered Account Information Service Provider regulated by Finland's Financial Supervisory Authority (FIN-FSA) and one of Europe's established Open Banking infrastructure providers.
openBankingApp.faq4Q: What happens if I disconnect my bank?
openBankingApp.faq4A: You can revoke access at any time, from WonderMoney or directly from your bank's app. Historical data already synced stays in your account unless you delete it.
openBankingApp.ctaHeadline: Connect Your Bank Accounts the Secure Way
openBankingApp.ctaBody: Link your accounts via Open Banking and let WonderMoney keep your financial picture up to date automatically. Free and open source.

budgetApp.heroTitle: The Budget App That Updates Itself
budgetApp.heroSubtitle: WonderMoney connects to your bank via Open Banking, imports and categorises your transactions automatically, and shows you exactly what's left in every budget category — no manual entry required.
budgetApp.metaDescription: WonderMoney is a budget app that connects to your European bank accounts via Open Banking, automatically categorises transactions, and helps you budget by category — solo or with a partner.
budgetApp.feature1Body: Set a monthly budget for rent, groceries, transport, and more. WonderMoney matches incoming transactions to the right category automatically.
budgetApp.feature2Body: Your bank transactions sync daily via Open Banking. WonderMoney categorises them automatically and deducts from the right budget.
budgetApp.feature3Body: Every category shows how much you've spent and how much is left, so overspending shows up before the month is over, not after.
budgetApp.feature4Body: Compare what you planned to spend against what you actually spent, category by category, and adjust next month accordingly.
budgetApp.feature5Body: Multi-currency support (EUR, GBP, USD and 8 more), so budgets work whether your accounts are in one currency or several.
budgetApp.feature6Body: Household mode lets two people share budgets and categories, so couples can plan spending together instead of guessing.
budgetApp.how1Body: Create budget categories for the things you spend on — rent, groceries, transport, subscriptions — and set a monthly amount for each.
budgetApp.how2Body: Link your accounts via Open Banking. Transactions sync automatically and match to the right budget category.
budgetApp.how3Title: Review and adjust as you go
budgetApp.how3Body: Check your budgets anytime to see what's on track and what's overspent, and move money between categories when plans change.
budgetApp.faq1Q: Do I have to enter transactions manually?
budgetApp.faq1A: No. WonderMoney connects to your bank via Open Banking and imports transactions automatically, matching each one to a budget category.
budgetApp.faq2Q: What budgeting method does WonderMoney use?
budgetApp.faq2A: WonderMoney supports category-based budgeting: you allocate a monthly amount to each category, and spending is tracked against it automatically as transactions arrive.
budgetApp.faq3Q: Can I budget with my partner?
budgetApp.faq3A: Yes. Household mode lets two people share budgets, categories, and accounts in one place, with billing managed by a single plan.
budgetApp.faq4A: Yes. WonderMoney is free to use at wonder.money, or you can run it on your own server.
budgetApp.ctaHeadline: Start Budgeting Without the Manual Work
budgetApp.ctaBody: Connect your bank accounts and let WonderMoney track your budget automatically. Free and open source.

adNetWorth.metaTitle: Do You Know What You're Worth? — WonderMoney
adNetWorth.metaDescription: See your complete net worth in one place — bank accounts, investments, and debts combined automatically. Free and open source.
adNetWorth.heroTitle: Do you actually know what you're worth?
adNetWorth.heroSubtitle: Most people can tell you their salary to the euro. Almost nobody can tell you their real net worth. WonderMoney connects your accounts and investments to show you the number that actually matters.
adNetWorth.painTitle: Why most people have no idea
adNetWorth.pain1Body: A current account here, a savings account there, an investment platform somewhere else. Nobody adds it all up — so nobody knows the real total.
adNetWorth.pain2Body: Even if you built a net worth spreadsheet once, updating it by hand every month is the first habit to slip.
adNetWorth.pain3Body: Net worth isn't just what you own — it's what you own minus what you owe. Most people only track one side of that equation.
adNetWorth.how1Body: Link your bank accounts and investment platforms via secure, read-only Open Banking.
adNetWorth.how2Body: Balances, portfolio value, and debts combine into one net worth figure that updates as your providers supply new data.
adNetWorth.how3Body: See your net worth trend month by month, so you know if you're actually moving in the right direction.
adNetWorth.ctaHeadline: Find out what you're actually worth
adNetWorth.ctaBody: Connect your accounts and see your real net worth — automatically, in one place.

adFragmentation.metaTitle: One App Instead of Five — WonderMoney
adFragmentation.metaDescription: Stop juggling bank apps, broker apps, and spreadsheets. See every account in one place with WonderMoney. Free and open source.
adFragmentation.heroTitle: 5 bank apps. 2 broker apps. 1 spreadsheet. There's a better way.
adFragmentation.heroSubtitle: You shouldn't need six logins to answer one question: how am I doing financially? WonderMoney brings every account into a single view.
adFragmentation.painTitle: Juggling apps costs you more than time
adFragmentation.pain1Title: You check five apps and still don't know the answer
adFragmentation.pain1Body: Each app shows one slice of your finances. None of them shows the whole picture — so the real question stays unanswered.
adFragmentation.pain2Title: The spreadsheet is always out of date
adFragmentation.pain2Body: You built it once to tie everything together. Updating it by hand every month is the part that never survives.
adFragmentation.pain3Body: When your accounts live in five different places, it's easy for a subscription or fee to slip past you unseen.
adFragmentation.how1Body: Link your bank accounts and investment platforms via secure, read-only Open Banking — no more switching apps.
adFragmentation.how2Body: Balances, spending, and investments sit side by side, automatically categorized and kept in sync.
adFragmentation.how3Body: Open WonderMoney and get the full picture — no more app-hopping to piece it together.
adFragmentation.ctaBody: Connect every account and see your whole financial picture in a single place.

adOpenBanking.metaTitle: Your Bank Has to Share Your Data If You Ask — WonderMoney
adOpenBanking.metaDescription: EU law requires your bank to share your data with apps you authorize. WonderMoney uses this to show your full financial picture automatically. Free and open source.
adOpenBanking.heroTitle: Your bank is legally required to share your data with apps you authorize. Most people don't know this.
adOpenBanking.heroSubtitle: Open Banking (PSD2) gives you the right to connect your accounts to apps like WonderMoney — securely, and only with your permission. It turns five separate logins into one clear picture.
adOpenBanking.painTitle: The right most people never use
adOpenBanking.pain1Title: It's not a workaround — it's the law
adOpenBanking.pain1Body: Under PSD2, EU banks must let you share your account data with authorized apps, on your terms.
adOpenBanking.pain2Title: Your bank still holds your money
adOpenBanking.pain2Body: Open Banking is read-only. WonderMoney can see your data to show it to you — it can't move money or make payments.
adOpenBanking.pain3Body: You choose which accounts to connect, and you can disconnect at any time from your bank or from WonderMoney.
adOpenBanking.how1Body: Pick your bank and confirm the connection directly with them — WonderMoney never sees your banking credentials.
adOpenBanking.how2Body: Your bank shares balances and transactions with WonderMoney under the permission you granted. Nothing more.
adOpenBanking.how3Title: See it all in one place
adOpenBanking.how3Body: Every connected account feeds into a single dashboard — balances, spending, and net worth, kept in sync.
adOpenBanking.ctaHeadline: Put your legal right to work
adOpenBanking.ctaBody: Connect your accounts and see your full financial picture — securely, on your terms.
